- scripts/review_findings_record.py:529-537 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `build_record`, `consolidator_ran` becomes True whenever the issues file has any non-whitespace text, even when the file has no `=== ISSUE <n> ===` block (for example garbage, or only `=== ISSUE PASSTHROUGH nnn ===` blocks).
  WHY: scripts/review_parse_consolidator.sh defaults `REVIEW_PARSER_FAILOPEN=1` (line 434), truncates on no-markers only when fail-open is off (lines 902-911), and rewrites the file at line 969, so a failed-open round records `consolidator.ran=true, issue_count=0` without `issues_file_empty`; this contradicts the agents-fragment contract and corrupts Phase 3/Phase 4 round classification. All four reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_findings_record.py:424-429 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `parse_editor_summary`, the `break` in the `Change status:` loop sits outside `if value in ("edited", "not-edited")`, so only the first bullet is ever checked.
  WHY: The editor summary is written by an LLM, so a blank or invalid first bullet followed by `- edited` makes the record report `editor.change_status="unknown"`, which corrupts the trial comparison data; the fix is to move the `break` inside the `if` (1 line). Severities disagree: gemini, minimax and glm rated it MAJOR, sonnet and luna rated it NIT, so the highest is used.
- scripts/review_findings_record.py:314-318 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The LENS, SEVERITY, CLASSIFICATION and REJECTION_KIND header values in `parse_review_issues` are checked only for syntax (`TOKEN_RE`/`LENS_RE`), and `TOKEN_RE` accepts credential-shaped values such as `ghp_...`; unlike editor reasons, they are never passed through `redact_secrets`.
  WHY: scripts/review_parse_consolidator.sh passes these headers through from LLM output without redaction (lines 670-679), so a credential would be written to review_findings_record.json and kept in the 30-day artifact, against the linked issue's no-credentials requirement.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_findings_record.py:build_record, lines 529-531 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `consolidator.ran` is set to true whenever the issues file has any non-whitespace text, even if it has no `=== ISSUE <n> ===` block; on a fail-open parse failure (REVIEW_PARSER_FAILOPEN defaults to 1 at line 434, truncation only when fail-open is off at line 907, rewrite at line 969) the file holds only PASSTHROUGH blocks.
  WHY: The same failure records `ran: true, issue_count: 0` when anchors are left and `ran: false` plus `issues_file_empty` when there are none, which contradicts the agents fragment; the suggested fix is to gate `consolidator_ran` on an `ISSUE_START_RE` pre-scan (next to the line 327 scan) and add an `issues_file_no_blocks` warning.
- scripts/review_findings_record.py:parse_editor_summary, lines 424-429 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The unconditional `break` (line 429) sits outside the `if`, so only the first `Change status:` bullet is checked.
  WHY: A blank or extra first bullet followed by `- edited` produces `editor.change_status: "unknown"`; Copilot raised the same point in entry[11]; the fix is to move the `break` inside the `if`.
- .github/workflows (check run "orchestrate-poll (1)", job 128713211363, head 791fbc2) | severity=NIT | confidence=2

  WHY: The cause cannot be found in the tail; raised for the editor to check the full log or rerun the job, not claimed as a defect in this PR.
- HARDENING (not a finding): scripts/review_findings_record.py parse_review_issues `finish()` dict lines 314-318 — LENS/SEVERITY are passed through unchecked by review_parse_consolidator.sh (lines 589-590, 674-675), and `TOKEN_RE` accepts `ghp_...`; suggested fix is to route header values and `file_value` through `_load_redactor()`, set the value to None when redacted, and add a `header_value_redacted` warning (8 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- Notes: TASK COMPLETENESS = NONE; the passthrough pre-scan at lines 324-328 and `test_passthrough_warning_survives_issue_cap` were verified correct, and all four Phase 3 plan items are present.
